_authority: Master Series Map & Schedule v5 · Continuity Locks tab. 'The contradiction-free production canon that overrides outdated wording in legacy documents.' Reopen a lock only with a named approver, a documented reason and a sweep of every downstream asset.

locks.rule: Always 'Thistlewood's' with the apostrophe. 'Thistlewoods' is internal shorthand only.
26 × 11-minute episodes; two 13-episode seasons.
7–11 with family co-viewing; books positioned for 8–12.
Third ground-floor unit on the left from the Castle Street entrance; no staircase.
Curved bow window left; narrow glazed door; dark green panel and brass maker's mark.
Rear right, facing the entrance; clear route around it to the workshop arch.
Shelves, radio, stove and kettle.
Workbench and brick window. The good chair sits on the RIGHT side of the room, between the tool cabinet and the window wall — Rose's place.
locks._earned: The manuscript says 'the good chair by the window' and the chair was specced hard against the window. Three generations placed it consistently between the tool cabinet and the window wall instead, reading correctly every time. Canon amended to what is reproducible rather than fighting it in every workshop shot for twenty-six episodes.

locks.rule: Oak door centred in stone; capital-T iron strap plus a separate lower strap.
145 cm; tallest child.
140 cm; eldest and action leader.
132 cm; visibly smaller than Lily and Albert.
118 cm; always the smallest.
Brown hair; brown jumper; notebook and pencil; ROUND GLASSES. Albert and Richard both wear glasses.
locks._earned: Reversal, 2026-08-13. Julian first called Albert's glasses drift, but three full generations refused to remove them, including one describing his face positively as bare. Ruling: roll with it and lock them IN. A lock that says 'no glasses' against art that always has them guarantees the character changes face mid-episode. Consistency beats the original preference.

locks.rule: Dormant (dark, inert, furniture) until the shop door clicks shut behind Tom Chen. Backlit (a thin seam of other-coloured light around a closed door) only from that moment. PL-06 and PL-07 respectively.
locks._why: The glow is the cold open's payoff and Act One's turn. Lit early, the episode spends its biggest moment before the title card.

door_canon: It opens only for an object with an unfinished truth.
One present-world hour. No one is left behind.
The compass sleeps until understanding is earned.
Only the missing repair fragment may ordinarily cross back.
History cannot be rewritten; the children witness, reveal and recover.
The wrong clothes are deliberate — and eventually meaningful.
Any exception is a serial clue, never a convenient escape hatch.

inherited_machinery.apron: understanding — Richard feels what matters, never the full story, never the easy answer
inherited_machinery.compass: direction — points only after the children understand enough to deserve the next step; effort first, magic second
inherited_machinery.paint: permanence — the sign's gold never fades and the tin never empties; Albert records the anomaly long before anyone explains it
inherited_machinery.origin: all three arrived at the shop in 1922; the traveller, the price and the choice of Septimus remain the mystery beneath the mysteries
